subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Which memory roles should become public slots now, given that only recall and compaction have concrete agent-aware runtime routing in this patch?
rationale: The permanent plugin and configuration taxonomy depends on whether OpenClaw should publish role selectors before their generic lifecycle APIs exist; code review cannot safely choose that product contract.

options.title: Land proven roles first
options.body: Limit this PR to recall and compaction, then add capture, dreaming, and user modeling through later changes with complete lifecycle contracts.

options.title: Complete all five roles
options.body: Keep the full taxonomy but implement and prove agent-aware invocation for every advertised role before merge.

options.title: Pause for the memory RFC
options.body: Hold this PR until the RFC defines all role ownership, fallback, inheritance, and invocation semantics.

recommendation.title: Land proven roles first
recommendation.body: Limit this PR to recall and compaction, then add capture, dreaming, and user modeling through later changes with complete lifecycle contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and broad ownership connect this person to the plugin-slot, memory runtime, dreaming, Active Memory, and public-surface decisions involved.
